clue.text: He makes good furniture, concerned with getting ahead

indicators.note: getting ahead says the short piece goes at the front of the furniture word

parts.note: re is the Latin-derived word meaning about or concerning
a dresser is a piece of furniture, a sideboard with shelves for crockery

explanation.surface: A craftsman who repairs furniture, keen to get on in his trade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Makes good' looks like it describes the furniture-maker, but it is the definition: to redress is to put right.
explanation.definitionFit: To redress a wrong is to remedy or put it right, so one who does so makes amends.

clue.text: Points some love to make, providing material for paper

parts.note: E and S are compass points, east and south
part means some of something
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Advice on scoring and romance, apparently offered to a papermaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Love' is the tennis score of nothing, shaped like O.
explanation.definitionFit: Esparto is a tough grass from Spain and North Africa used in making fine paper.

clue.text: May be composed or tries to be merry

indicators.note: composed here means put together afresh, so the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone trying hard, or calmly, to enjoy themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Composed' reads as calm, but it signals that OR TRIES is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To roister is to revel noisily and boisterously, an old word for making merry.

clue.text: A person running out of personal cover

definitions.text: A person running out of personal cover

parts.words: A person running out of personal cover
parts.note: read as someone dashing about having shed their clothes, as at a sports ground, rather than someone leaving shelter

explanation.surface: Someone running out from behind a personal shield or shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out of personal cover' suggests leaving a hiding place; it really means wearing no clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Such a person runs naked through a public place, often a sporting event, for a dare.

clue.text: Combat is in the balance

indicators.note: in says the word is goes inside the word for balance

parts.note: the balance is the rest, what remains

explanation.surface: A fight whose outcome hangs in the balance.
explanation.definitionFit: To combat something is to fight against or oppose it, a synonym.

clue.text: Hand around games. Travellers need them

indicators.note: around says the word for hand wraps round the word for games

parts.note: to pass something is to hand it over
sport covers games collectively

explanation.surface: Distributing games among people, followed by a note that travellers need them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Games' is plural but stands for sport in general; 'around' means the word for hand wraps round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Official identity documents are required for travel abroad, so people crossing borders need them.

clue.text: Family doctor at home — he's most important

parts.note: kin are one's family or relations
a GP is a general practitioner, a family doctor in Britain
in means at home, not out

explanation.surface: A family doctor at home, proud to be the key figure.
explanation.walkthrough: A GP (general practitioner) is the British family doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief person in an organisation, on whom all depends, is its central figure.

clue.text: Being aware of some words written about one

indicators.note: about says the word for written words goes around the one

parts.note: a sentence is a group of written words
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Consciousness of a few written words about oneself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Being aware' looks like a participle phrase, but it works as a noun here; 'about' means the written words go round the one.
explanation.definitionFit: Sentience is the capacity to feel and perceive, the condition of being conscious.

clue.text: Question cut-back by colliery

indicators.note: back says the word for cut is read in reverse

parts.note: to axe is to cut
a colliery is a coal mine

explanation.surface: Asking about cutbacks at a coal pit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut-back' looks like a single noun for a reduction; 'back' turns AXE into EXA.
explanation.definitionFit: To question someone closely is to interrogate or inspect them, a synonym.

clue.text: A superior — one reasoning logically

parts.note: taken as written
a prior is the superior of a religious house
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A monastic superior who argues things out rationally.
explanation.walkthrough: A prior heads a priory, below an abbot.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase describes deductive argument from principles, before experience, so it denotes logical deduction.

clue.text: Visible perspicacity

explanation.surface: Clear, observable sharpness of mind.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as two words, the answer means able to be seen; as one, it means deep understanding.
explanation.definitionFit: Something within view is visible, and perspicacity is keen understanding or discernment.

clue.text: Keeps going for brochures

parts.note: pro is Latin for for, as in pros and cons
tracts are pamphlets or leaflets

explanation.surface: Someone who carries on supporting printed brochures.
explanation.definitionFit: To prolong something is to keep it going longer, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Say diet change is essential in this area of Scotland

indicators.note: change tells us to alter the order of the letters of the words before it

explanation.surface: Advising that a change of diet matters in a Scottish region.
explanation.walkthrough: Tayside is a former Scottish region around the River Tay, including Dundee and Perth.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a former administrative region of eastern Scotland named after the River Tay.

clue.text: Toper in a bad way due to poison

indicators.note: in a bad way suggests a mess, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A drinker in poor shape because of something toxic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a bad way' reads as one phrase, but IN A is part of the anagram with TOPER.
explanation.definitionFit: Atropine is a toxic alkaloid from deadly nightshade.

clue.text: Where one may see golfers duck inside to swear

indicators.note: inside says the duck goes within the word for swear

parts.note: to curse is to swear
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, the letter O

explanation.surface: Golfers cursing as they duck for cover.
explanation.walkthrough: A duck is a zero in cricket, shaped like O.
explanation.definitionFit: Golf is played on a laid-out stretch of land, so golfers are seen there.

clue.text: A woman who's opposed to standing

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
a stance is a way of standing, or a position

explanation.surface: A woman who takes a stand against something.
explanation.definitionFit: Constance is a female given name.

clue.text: Rebel leader having to fight as cut off

parts.note: to spar is to fight, as boxers do

indicators.note: off suggests gone wrong, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rebel chief forced to fight, as supplies are cut off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Off' rearranges AS CUT to TACUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Spartacus was the gladiator who led the slave revolt against Rome.

clue.text: Now to get something special for Christmas!

explanation.surface: Urging someone to fetch a special Christmas treat at once.
explanation.definitionFit: The time now is the current moment, and a gift is what one gives at Christmas.

clue.text: A relatively biased individual

parts.note: relatively is read as favouring relatives, not as comparatively

explanation.surface: Someone who is fairly prejudiced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relatively' seems to mean somewhat; here it means towards relatives.
explanation.definitionFit: Such a person favours family members, for example with jobs.

clue.text: Give voice about a sportsman rising to great heights

indicators.note: about says the word for give voice goes around the sportsman

parts.note: to sing is to give voice
an oar is a rower, a sportsman in a boat

explanation.surface: Singing about an athlete whose career is climbing high.
explanation.walkthrough: An oar is a crossword stand-in for an oarsman.
explanation.definitionFit: To soar is to fly or climb high, so climbing upward high describes it.

clue.text: Property among the very finest — a tenant pays a high rent

indicators.note: among tells us to look inside the following words for a run of letters

explanation.surface: A grand house among the very best, where a tenant pays steep rent.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters sit in finEST A TEnant; the closing words only complete the picture of a pricey home.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate is a landed property, a large house with grounds.

clue.text: After the trial dined with a will

indicators.note: after says the eating word follows the trial word

parts.note: a test is a trial
ate means dined

explanation.surface: Eating heartily after the court case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'With a will' suggests enthusiasm; it means having made a will.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who dies having left a valid will is said to die so.

clue.text: White-collar workers reporting?

explanation.surface: Office workers who pass on stories.
explanation.walkthrough: Bank clerks are one sense; people who tell, or report, are the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Bank cashiers are office staff, and narrators are those who tell or recount.

clue.text: Moved forward to surround the commanding officer when beaten

indicators.note: to surround says the word for moved forward goes around the officer

parts.note: surged means rushed forward
CO is the military abbreviation for commanding officer

explanation.surface: Troops advancing on their commander once defeated.
explanation.definitionFit: To scourge is to whip or flog, so the past form means flogged.

clue.text: The French may appear in uniform as a team

indicators.note: in says the French word goes inside the uniform word

parts.note: even means uniform or regular
le is the French masculine word for the

explanation.surface: French players turning out in team kit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uniform' looks like kit, but it is an adjective meaning level.
explanation.definitionFit: A football or cricket side has that many players, so the number names the side.

clue.text: There's fish and fruit only available

parts.note: a lemon is a citrus fruit
sole means only, as in sole survivor

explanation.surface: A menu note that fish and fruit are all that is on offer.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a European flatfish valued as food.

clue.text: Bill the heartless rogue will get time — a stretch

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letters of the word are removed

parts.note: an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A rogue facing a long prison stretch and a bill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get time' and 'stretch' suggest a prison sentence; stretch is an expanse of land.
explanation.definitionFit: Acreage is an area of land measured in acres, an expanse.

clue.text: A term in use for a sort of tower

indicators.note: use here means the letters are put to work in a new order

explanation.surface: A word in common usage for a type of tower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Use' rearranges A TERM IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A minaret is the slender tower of a mosque, from which the call to prayer is made.

clue.text: About to make certain criticism

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about
to ensure is to make certain

explanation.surface: Being about to be sure of disapproval.
explanation.definitionFit: Censure is strong disapproval or reprimand.

clue.text: Bearing on the star's get-up

indicators.note: get-up suggests a costume or rearrangement, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A celebrity's outfit has an effect on how they carry themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bearing' seems to mean deportment; it is a compass direction.
explanation.definitionFit: A compass bearing names a direction, and this one lies halfway between two cardinal points.
